title: Architecture
description: Compare the structure people approved with the dependencies an agent observed, then decide what changes next.
recordCheckedFolder: Checked {date} against a content fingerprint of the source folder
dependencyLowerOnly: Each layer may import only the layers below it.
dependencyExplicit: The profile names which layers each layer may import.
copyHandoff: Copy the sentence for your agent
copiedHandoff: Copied. Paste it into your agent
noProfiles: This codebase's structure has not been recorded yet
noProfilesBody: A connected agent reads the folders and the real imports and proposes a draft. Review it, and accepting saves one file.
roleNotInProfile: This profile has no layer called “{role}”. The link may be for a different profile.
sourceListingUnbound: No source folder is connected yet. Open the folder this profile describes and each layer lists its real modules.
draftNoAgentBody: No agent is connected. Copy the sentence and paste it into the coding agent you use.

agentTaskHints.inspect: Reads what the code actually pulls in and checks it against the reviewed structure.
agentTaskHints.recheck: Reads the code again and names what changed since the last receipt.
agentTaskHints.change: Writes a change plan that keeps this structure first.
agentTaskHints.improve: Names where structure and code disagree and where no rule exists, then asks you for the rule.

copiedTaskHandoff: Copied “{task}”. Paste it into your agent

draftPreview.exampleLabel: Example · not data from your folder
draftPreview.sourceLabel: Example · only the folder names come from {name}
draftPreview.descriptionExample: Example animation, not data from your folder: an agent reads the folders of {name} ({folders}) and their imports and proposes {layers} path groups; a person names them, from {top} down to {bottom}, and approving saves one file, {file}. Only then does a person set the dependency rules, and the check catches one import that climbs from {from} to {to}.
draftPreview.descriptionSource: Example animation; only the folder names are real, from your connected source folder {name} ({folders}), and what follows is an example: an agent reads these folders and their imports and proposes {layers} path groups; a person names them, from {top} down to {bottom}, and approving saves one file, {file}. Only then does a person set the dependency rules, and the check catches one import that climbs from {from} to {to}.

unknownReasons.unruled: {count, plural, one {# import} other {# imports}} no rule covers
unknownReasons.unmapped: {count, plural, one {# import} other {# imports}} from files in no layer
unknownReasons.coverage: some files are in a language the check cannot read

noRecordBody: Check the source and the table fills with the imports between layers.
matrixHowToRead: Each number is how many imports the row's layer makes into the column's layer. Imports inside one layer are not counted.

cell.observed: {from} → {to} · {count, plural, one {# import} other {# imports}} · allowed by the rules
cell.violation: {from} → {to} · {count, plural, one {# import} other {# imports}} against the rules
cell.allowed: {from} → {to} · no import · allowed by the rules
cell.forbidden: {from} → {to} · no import · not allowed by the rules
cell.uncounted: {from} → {to} · {count, plural, one {# import} other {# imports}} · not allowed, but of a kind the check does not count (such as type-only)

paneNotMeasured: Fills in after a source check
paneViolations: {count, plural, one {# import} other {# imports}} against the rules
